text:
Darren Raddysh came home to Toronto after a 70-point season in Tampa Bay and has had a slower start: one goal and 12 points in 20 games, eight of them on the power play. He's playing almost 24 minutes a night, more than anyone could have imagined for an undrafted defenseman a few years ago.

The shooting is the issue. He's at 2%, against a typical range of 6 to 9, after scoring 22 goals last season. That will turn, and LWOSports already argued Leafs fans shouldn't worry. What's harder to wave away is the team around him: Toronto has 47% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, on a team losing the chance battle most nights.

Evolving-Hockey had him 15th of 215 defensemen in wins above replacement last season, with the caveat that strong teammates helped. He finally got his first goal as a Leaf this week. Our range has him at 53 to 78 points.
